title: Just a Light Clear
description: make your light block look more clear.
body:
**Just a Light Clear** - it's a very simple resource pack that replaces only one texture — the light — and nothing else. The new texture will only be visible when you're holding the light in your hand.

This resource pack is mainly intended for creative players who don’t like the default large light texture.

**What this resource pack is for and who it’s for:**

1.  For better visibility through lights.
1.  For builders who need a clear view while working with lights.
1.  For server creators who use lights as lighting and want to reduce eye strain.

**This resource pack does not make invisible light blocks always visible — it is designed for a very specific use case.**
